**Frame:** Verso. Curt performs the final manuscript build. [Page 118](118.md) is still concealed by a black thumbnail.

**Action:** Source packets, corrections, and uncertainty labels compile beside the reading edition. A cover proof reads `THE TWO ANTHILL PROBLEM`. Beside it, a discarded connected-hills sketch remains visible under a heavy cancellation stroke; the kept sketch has two separate surfaces and unmarked space between. A revision slip reads `9 SEPTEMBER 2026 — TITLE REVISION`. Neither sketch has a queen, chamber, or individual agent identity. Two tiny authored ants sit in the desk’s light; they do not stand for particular runs.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> Two incidents. How many went unseen?

**Screen / system text — CHATGPT:**
> The picture cannot answer that.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` — project publication scene.

", "title": "The title revision keeps the evidence boundary" } }
